safe_handling_tip: If you find someone's item, submit it to Security or Student Affairs. Do not share personal details publicly.

replies.greeting: 👋 Hello! Welcome to FindMate. How can I help you today? Are you looking for a lost item or reporting a found item?
replies.empty: Please enter your message. Tell me what you lost or found.
replies.thanks: ✅ You're welcome! Feel free to ask if you need anything else. Have a great day!
replies.default: I didn't quite understand that. Please tell me what you lost or found, and I'll help you out!

lost_replies.id_card:
📋 Looking for your ID card?

✓ Check the Student Affairs Office
✓ Check the Library Reception
✓ Visit the Security Office

Tip: If you've lost it recently, contact Student Affairs immediately to report it.
lost_replies.wallet:
💳 Lost your wallet?

✓ Check the Security Office first
✓ Check the Student Affairs Office
✓ Try the Cafeteria and Canteen
✓ Check your last classroom

Tip: Contact the respective offices quickly to increase the chances of recovery.
lost_replies.charger:
🔌 Looking for a charger?

✓ Check Computer Lab 2
✓ Check Computer Lab 4
✓ Visit the Lost & Found desk (Security/Student Affairs)
✓ Ask lab staff - chargers are commonly left near computers

Tip: Tell them your charger model/type for easier identification.
lost_replies.book:
📖 Lost a book?

✓ Check the Library counter
✓ Check your last classroom
✓ Report it at the Lost & Found desk

Tip: Provide the book title and author name for quick identification.
lost_replies.keys:
🔑 Looking for your keys?

✓ Check the Security Office
✓ Check the main gate desk
✓ Keys are often submitted at Security

Tip: Describe your keychain to help staff identify it faster.
lost_replies.usb:
💾 Lost a USB/Pendrive?

✓ Check Computer Lab 2 and Lab 4
✓ Ask the Lab In-charge
✓ Check the Lost & Found desk
✓ USBs are commonly left near PCs

Tip: Provide any distinguishing features of your USB.
lost_replies.default:
📍 Item lost?

✓ Check the Lost & Found office at Student Affairs
✓ Visit the Security Office
✓ Check the location where you last remember having it

Tip: Report it as soon as possible for better recovery chances!

found_replies.id_card:
✅ Great! You found an ID card.

Please submit it to:
📍 Student Affairs Office OR
📍 Library Reception

Do NOT share personal details publicly. These offices will help return it to the owner.
found_replies.wallet:
✅ Wonderful! You found a wallet.

Please submit it to:
📍 Security Office OR
📍 Student Affairs Office

Do NOT open it or share personal details. The offices will contact the owner.
found_replies.charger:
✅ Good find! You found a charger.

Please submit it to:
📍 Computer Lab In-charge OR
📍 Security Office

Mention where you found it to help identify the owner.
found_replies.book:

Please submit it to:
📍 Library Counter OR
📍 Student Affairs Office

Include the book title and any details you noticed.
found_replies.keys:

Please submit them to:

found_replies.usb:

Please submit it to:

found_replies.default:
✅ Thank you for finding and reporting this item!

Please submit the found item to:
📍 Security Office OR
📍 Student Affairs Office

They will ensure it gets back to its owner. Appreciate your honesty!
